_comment: Days adsb.lol cannot give us. The extract planner skips them (plan_days.py --skip-unavailable) so a known upstream gap does not fail every scheduled run. The build does not read this file: its days gate still counts them as missing. Add a day only after it has failed the same way on a re-run.
